title: Introduction to Data Analysis with Pandas
description: Learn how to use the Pandas library to manipulate, analyze, and visualize data efficiently.

lessons.title: What is Pandas?
lessons.content: Pandas is a powerful open-source Python library designed for data manipulation and analysis, offering data structures like Series and DataFrame for handling structured data.

lessons.title: Installing and Importing Pandas
lessons.content:
Install Pandas using pip:
```
pip install pandas
```
Import Pandas in your script:
```python
import pandas as pd
```

lessons.title: Understanding Series and DataFrames
lessons.content: Series is a one-dimensional labeled array, while DataFrame is a two-dimensional table with labeled rows and columns, similar to a spreadsheet.

lessons.title: Creating Series and DataFrames
lessons.content:
Create a Series:
```python
s = pd.Series([10, 20, 30, 40])
print(s)
```
Create a DataFrame:
```python
df = pd.DataFrame({'Name': ['Alice', 'Bob'], 'Age': [25, 30]})
print(df)
```

lessons.title: Reading Data from Files
lessons.content:
Read CSV and Excel files:
```python
df_csv = pd.read_csv('data.csv')
df_excel = pd.read_excel('data.xlsx')
```

lessons.title: Exploring DataFrames
lessons.content:
View data samples and structure:
```python
print(df.head())
print(df.info())
print(df.describe())
```

lessons.title: Selecting and Filtering Data
lessons.content:
Select columns and filter rows:
```python
age_column = df['Age']
adults = df[df['Age'] > 18]
```

lessons.title: Handling Missing Data
lessons.content:
Detect, fill, or drop missing values:
```python
df.isnull()
df.fillna(0, inplace=True)
df.dropna(inplace=True)
```

lessons.title: Data Aggregation and Grouping
lessons.content:
Group data and compute aggregates:
```python
grouped = df.groupby('Category').mean()
print(grouped)
```

lessons.title: Basic Data Visualization with Pandas
lessons.content:
Plot data using Pandas built-in plot:
```python
df['Age'].plot(kind='hist')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
plt.show()
```
